limits: Isolated missile trials use mature synthetic arsenals and known original v111 rules, not multiplayer opponents.
Child impact placement is random; hidden rapid reload, future defenses or server changes can invalidate saturation estimates.
The short paired country/water/frozen-agent engineering runs establish execution, not superior strength; final land varies and some cases are lower than v3.1.
Warships only cover connected water and accessible coasts; defensive fleet is bounded at 32, salvo at six launches.
No entitlement is granted; a declared owned Scattershot enables ordinary attempts until an observed server inventory confirms or denies it.
No original game source, private reports, engine bundle or trained weights are redistributed.
